mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_flow_snapshot (snap_date, market, frgn_buy, frgn_sell, frgn_net, orgn_buy, orgn_sell, orgn_net, indv_buy, indv_sell, indv_net, updated_at) VALUES (#{snapDate}, #{market}, #{frgnBuy}, #{frgnSell}, #{frgnNet}, #{orgnBuy}, #{orgnSell}, #{orgnNet}, #{indvBuy}, #{indvSell}, #{indvNet}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (snap_date, market) DO UPDATE SET frgn_buy = EXCLUDED.frgn_buy, frgn_sell = EXCLUDED.frgn_sell, frgn_net = EXCLUDED.frgn_net, orgn_buy = EXCLUDED.orgn_buy, orgn_sell = EXCLUDED.orgn_sell, orgn_net = EXCLUDED.orgn_net, indv_buy = EXCLUDED.indv_buy, indv_sell = EXCLUDED.indv_sell, indv_net = EXCLUDED.indv_net, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, snap_date, market, frgn_buy, frgn_sell, frgn_net, orgn_buy, orgn_sell, orgn_net, indv_buy, indv_sell, indv_net FROM market_flow_snapshot WHERE market = #{market} ORDER BY snap_date DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
